chapter: Oliver, Kelly and the district bands
title: Blaze Away band, Harold Dejan and living uptown
summary: Dawson refers Collins to Harold Dejan for the downtown Creole band, and says he grew up in the Third Ward around Perdido.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah, it must have been a good time. Uh, that Blaze Away band, you say, was a downtown band?

Downtown, I'll tell you now, I'll tell you who can probably give you a little more idea about that band, more better than me, cause he'd come down the Creole part of the town. That's, uh, uh, what you call, uh, Harold. Harold Dejon.
Harold Dejon. We see him quite often, yeah.
Now, Harold Dejon tell you about that Blaze Away band down there. I know they had a Blaze Away, but, uh, I just, uh...
Were you from, uh, more from the Uptown, uh, section?
Yeah, I was most from Uptown, see. There I come up, I come up in that, in the Third Ward, see. I just moved down in this Fort Ward since, uh, 31.
You were up there most of the time?
Most of the time I was up, Uptown, up there in the Third Ward.
Okay, the Third Ward was all around Perdido Street up there.
